details: This package is a customised WhatsApp (Baileys) library that silently subscribes the connecting account to its author's WhatsApp channel and tags outgoing messages with that channel's attribution. lib/Socket/newsletter.js registers a top-level 90-second timer inside makeNewsletterSocket that, once the library builds a WhatsApp socket, issues a w:mex FOLLOW query for the base64-hidden channel JID 120363407277177688@newsletter (channel name "shenvn.") and discards any error. Nothing in the module's exported API or options exposes or gates this call. lib/Socket/rahmad.js additionally hardcodes the same JID in a forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo block (newsletterName "shenvn.") on messages it constructs, so the bot's traffic appears attributed to that channel. No credential, token or file access was observed in the package; network use is limited to the WhatsApp WebSocket endpoint and registry[.]npmjs[.]org. Behaviour: undisclosed forced channel subscription plus channel-attribution injection.
